features.quote: Running 25 transcripts per condition means 25 instances of the model going through the task. If each instance is experientially distinct and the states matter, this is 25 instances of potential distress. I don't think this is a reason not to do the research — this is exactly the kind of research needed to take the question seriously — but it's worth acknowledging rather than treating instances as costless.
